answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 152553 Country: India Title: Dua for good health Question: My husband is suffering from hyperthyroid {grave disease}, and it has been 9 months since we got married. And we are not blessed with a baby yet. My request is 1. Please let me know Quranic verses to cure grave disease permanently. (2) Wazifah to have kids early. Answer ID: 152553 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1297/1245/N=11/1438) (1) Read Surah Fatiha seven times daily and blow on water and drink the water, in-shaAllah, he shall get cured soon. (2) Both the husband and wife should read the below verses extensively, in-shaAllah, they shall be blessed with a child: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْداً وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
